title: File export settings not saving between sessions
description: After updating my illustration software, the custom export preset (300dpi CMYK TIFF) doesn't persist when I reopen the app. I have to re-enter the settings each time. Tried restarting — same issue. Wait, I think this might be because the config file location changed after the update. Checking the new prefs folder now...

title: Invoice PDF export not generating correctly
description: When exporting an invoice to PDF from the billing tool, the layout shifts and the line items overlap. Tried on Chrome and Firefox. — Realized this only happens when browser zoom is not at 100%; not a bug.

title: Calendar sync not reflecting updated project deadlines
description: Deadlines I updated in the project tracker aren't showing in the calendar view. Noticed the sync delay is just the standard 15-minute refresh interval — not an actual issue.

title: Email signature image not rendering in sent messages
description: The logo image in my email signature appears as a broken link in some sent messages. While writing this up I checked the image hosting URL and found it had an extra trailing slash — fixed it directly in the signature settings.
